description: "Orthodoxy: Its Truths And Errors" by James Freeman Clarke is a theological treatise written in the late 19th century. The work aims to explore the principles of orthodoxy, examining both its claimed truths and inherent errors, as well as engaging with opposing viewpoints, particularly from a Unitarian perspective.
